title: Mist SMP
description: Welcome to Mist SMP. This isn't just another smp that dies in three days,  it is one masive competition to be the richest player and rule the others, build, kill and progress to grow and when you are ready enter our new dimension The Mist. Join Now!
body: Welcome to **Mist SMP**. This isn't just another smp that dies in three days, it is one masive competition to be the richest player and rule the others, gather your power by defeating other meanwhile you build your empire, build farms, raid bases, rule wars and become the strongest player on the server!
